context: Oh hey how are you doing today? Are you looking for a movie recommendation?
yes how are you
I'm doing great! :) So what types of movies are you interested in?
I mostly like romantic comedies, and family comedies, I can watch anything under the sun but I cannot watch horror movies.
Wow rom-coms they are the best! And I know what you mean about horror movies being too scary
They are just feel good movies so it places you in a good and happy mood.
Would you happen to remember the last rom-com you watched and liked?
Yes I watched fifty shades of freed.
I see! What did you like about that movie?

I think its more on the plot and the story line since i have watched the previous movies to its sequel. I also admire the actors and actresses, it looks like a well funded movie, and it is 'mainstream', you just have to watch it to be in the 'incrowd' i guess.
Oh interesting there's a movie I think you will love then!! It's called A Star Is Born
I accept your recommendation for a movie. I cant wait to watch it.
Great! It's got an all-star cast with Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper :)
I know I have searched it on google. Thanks again!
Please enjoy the film :)
I will do it seems like its going to be an epic film. Do you have other movies in mind?
Hmm if you like epic movies I may recommend the recent Disney Star Wars series or Marvel's Black Panther
I have watch the Black Panther I enjoyed that movie. Ive never been a star wars fan, though I watch the return of the saga. Thanks for the suggestions.
How about The Lord of the Rings trilogy? I loved watching those movies as a kid :)
That sounds interesting!

context.content: Hi! How are you today? You: Hi! I'm doing well, thanks for asking. I'm excited to chat with you about some great movies. What kind of movies are you in the mood for? Do you have a favorite genre or type of movie you'd like to watch?
I'm in the mood for a good comedy. Something that will make me laugh and maybe even think a bit.
Comedy is a great choice! To make some recommendations, can you tell me if you have a preference for a more light-hearted, slapstick comedy or something a bit more satirical or witty?
I prefer the latter, something that's clever and makes me think as well as laugh.
Based on your preference for clever and satirical comedy, I'd like to recommend a movie that fits the bill.
Sure, sounds good. What's the movie?
I'd recommend "Somebody Up There Likes Me" (2012). It's a comedy that combines witty dialogue with a satirical take on life's absurdities.
Can you tell me more about the plot and the actors involved?

[END] You: Sounds interesting! Can you tell me more about the plot and the actors involved? I want to make sure it's exactly what I'm looking for before I decide. You: Sure thing! "Somebody Up There Likes Me" is a comedy about a man who starts a cult to help him deal with his personal struggles. The movie features a mix of quirky characters and sharp humor. The main actor is Paul Rudd, who plays the cult leader, and he's joined by an ensemble cast including Maya Rudolph, Michael Cera, and Jason Segel. They all bring their A-game to the screen. You: That sounds like it could be right up my alley. Thanks for the detailed info! [END]
